# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Household manager and farmer  <sub>[v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c8 P2](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a stern facade that occasionally softens into a hesitant, stiff smile.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P13](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0013), [v1 c3 P22](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0022)_

## Personality

Thirza is a practical, firm, and straightforward woman who insists on deferential behavior, proper conduct, and prompt obedience. She strongly disdains romantic affectations or imaginary pretenses, believing that people should accept their circumstances as God intended without pretending things are different. Though she disapproves of emotional outbursts and maintains strict discipline, she possesses a keen sense of duty, fairness, and a softening heart toward those in her care.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P13](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0013), [v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)_

## Goals

- Properly train and raise Nell in Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)</sub>

## History

Thirza lives at Grey Shutters alongside her brother, Obed Abernethy. When they arranged for Mrs. Tranter to fetch a boy from the asylum to assist with farm work, an error resulted in the young orphan girl Nell Harcourt arriving at their home instead. Though initially confused by the mix-up, Thirza assured the weeping girl she would not be turned out into the cold and allowed her to stay temporarily. Over the following day, Thirza observed Nell's work habits closely and determined that she was intelligent, compliant, and prompt, despite her tendency to daydream. Consequently, Thirza and Obed resolved to keep and raise Nell at Grey Shutters. Later, when Mrs. Agatha Sowerby harshly mocked Nell's physical appearance and provoked a fierce outburst from the child, Thirza sent Nell to her room but surprisingly stood up for her against Mrs. Agatha's overly severe comments.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c3 P13](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0013), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)_

## Quotes

> Obed Abernethy, who is that? Where can the boy be?  <sub>[v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001)</sub>

> Nell is a truly excellent, simple, and practical name. There is no reason for you to feel embarrassed by it.  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>

> Obed and I have resolved to retain you—provided, that is, you attempt to be a dutiful little girl and prove that you are appreciative.  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>

> Agatha, it was wrong of you to mock her appearance.  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026)</sub>
